b: Artists have faced visa issues, increased transportation costs and more since the UK's exit from the European Union

Over 300 live music and cultural organisations have signed an open letter calling on Prime Minister Andy Burnham to address continued issues that UK artists face when touring countries in the European Union (EU).

Artists, performers and other cultural figures have faced "major barriers" to touring in the area since the UK left the EU in January 2020, according to the letter. These include issues surrounding visas, and increased costs in transporting instruments and other equipment, as well as various other logistical problems.
